subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Nissan GT-R
description: A quick win: understand The Nissan GT-R.

hook.text: The Nissan GT-R embarrassed supercars costing five times more. Magazines called it 'Godzilla.'

buildup.text: Its twin-turbo V6, all-wheel drive, and launch control made it brutally fast in a straight line.

discovery.text: It hit 60 mph in under 3 seconds when it launched in 2007—matching Ferraris and Lamborghinis.

twist.text: It cost $70,000 when a comparable Ferrari cost $300,000. The value gap was embarrassing for Europeans.

climax.text: The GT-R proved that engineering discipline could beat exotic materials and badge prestige.

punchline.text: Godzilla didn't need a fancy badge to dominate.

quiz.question: Why was the GT-R called 'Godzilla'?
options: It destroyed supercars at a fraction of the cost
